question.prompt: Point \(P(1,2)\) is translated 3 units to the right to obtain point \(P'\). Write the x-coordinate and y-coordinate of \(P'\) (separated by a comma).

solutions.explanation: Translating to the right adds 3 to the x-coordinate and leaves the y-coordinate unchanged, giving \(P'(4,2)\).
solutions.title: Horizontal translation
